scripts.build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:shared-types && npm run build -w @spotify-wallpaper/spotify-auth && npm run build -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper
scripts.build:optional: npm run build:shared-types && npm run build -w @spotify-wallpaper/configurator
scripts.wallpaper:dev-build: npm run build:wasm && npm run build:shared-types && npm run build -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper && npm run wallpaper:link
scripts.test:wasm-parity: node scripts/require-wasm-artifacts.mjs && npm run test -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper -- src/wasm/wasmParity.test.ts
scripts.scan:public-backend-secrets:all: node scripts/check-public-backend-secrets.mjs apps/spotify-auth/src apps/configurator/src apps/wallpaper/src packages/wallpaper-view/src packages/shared-types/src apps/spotify-auth/dist apps/configurator/dist apps/wallpaper/dist
scripts.verify:repository-authority: npm run test:repository-authority && npm run check:repository-authority && npm run check:repository-preservation
scripts.check: npm run check -w @spotify-wallpaper/shared-types && npm run check -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper-view && npm run check -w @spotify-wallpaper/spotify-auth && npm run check -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper
scripts.test: npm run test:repository-authority && npm run test:wallpaper-link && npm run test:security && npm run test -w @spotify-wallpaper/shared-types && npm run test -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper-view && npm run test -w @spotify-wallpaper/spotify-auth && npm run test -w @spotify-wallpaper/wallpaper
